nodes.title: Teardown lane squadstack (account-free): 69 graded claims (45 observed, 11 inferred, 12 vendor-claimed, 1 unknown) and 14 pre-registered predictions. Sources: about 60 marketing, legal and blog pages plus llms.txt and the 888-URL sitemap; the portal's public Next.js build manifest and 98 chunks; the AI-platform auth page HAR; the in-app SDK; the Vanta trust centre (subprocessors); the Postman API collection; the careers feed; Play Store and Capterra; DNS and AWS IP ranges; the public GitHub org. The harness refused report.md, so the report text is in the lane's structured output.

SquadStack architecture, observed in its own public code and trust centre: a provider-routed cascade on Pipecat (in-app SDK: @pipecat-ai/client-js 1.13.1 + Daily transport, POST /bot/connect). TTS options: ElevenLabs (default, eleven_multilingual_v2 on the India-residency endpoint), Cartesia Sonic 3.5/3.6, Sarvam. STT options: sarvam, cartesia, squadstack_ws, arc_stt, with fallback / best-latency / load-balance routing. Post-call extraction runs on OpenRouter Gemini 2.5 Flash. Subprocessors: Exotel, Ozonetel, Plivo (USA), OpenAI (USA), Google Gemini. All origins are in AWS ap-south-1; the backend is Django. Contradicts the marketing claim 'owned, not orchestrated', which holds at most for Arth ASR.

SquadStack, the managed incumbent with 60+ enterprise logos, is building self-serve in VP's lane. It runs an unlinked builder at ai-platform.squadstack.ai ('Build, deploy, and optimize personalized AI voice agents in minutes', Google sign-in). Osno AI (app.osno.ai) shares its Firebase project (squadstack-ai-paas) and SquadStack's code special-cases that host (inferred to be its own brand). Three Voice AI platform PM roles specify self-serve onboarding, APIs and SDKs. A Plug-N-Play SME path with wallet top-ups already exists in its portal.
nodes.mitigation: Win on what a self-serve rookie with a BPO data model lacks: minutes to first live call, a per-call technical failure reason, real-time AMD, compliance-by-construction (1600/140 routing, consent, fixed AI disclosure), and published pricing. Re-check ai-platform.squadstack.ai and app.osno.ai monthly through the change-watch.

nodes.title: SquadStack's public API is a 2024 Postman collection for lead ingestion only. It has per-campaign create/update/upsert/convert/disable/delete endpoints (bulk 100), basic auth, 100 requests/min and mandatory IP whitelisting; SquadStack creates the campaign. Data flows out as per-customer disposition webhooks (call event plus an end-of-journey 'judgement'). No developer docs, changelog or status page exist. The 61-route portal and the AI-platform agent object (temperature 0.5, max_tokens 100, max session 240 s, idle 10 s x 3, summarisation after 5 turns) give VP a parity reference.

Inference: SquadStack COGS per connected minute, ex GST, over its observed provider options. With ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 at PAYG (the bundle default) it is INR 3.3-5.3, a loss at INR 2 and roughly break-even at 3.5. With Cartesia Sonic-3.6 it is INR 1.9-3.5; with Sarvam Bulbul, INR 1.2-2.7; with self-hosted TTS, INR 0.7-2.1. The INR 2-5 band works only with own or Sarvam TTS, or a deep ElevenLabs discount.
nodes.n: 15 stack combinations (3 STT x 1 LLM proxy x 5 TTS) x lo/mid/hi
nodes.method: desk computation: g4 component list prices (2026-10-18) and model/results/inputs.csv (telephony INR 0.38-0.48, infra) applied to the providers observed in SquadStack's public bundles and trust centre; Gemini flash-lite used as an LLM proxy because the Gemini 2.5 Flash price was not read; not measured on SquadStack traffic

nodes.title: SquadStack India plumbing. Observed: a DNC blacklist marked 'verified DND by scrubbing', 10-digit validation, SMS blocks taking the customer's Sender ID and DLT Entity ID. Zero mentions of 140, 160 or 1600-series numbers across about 60 pages, llms.txt and the portal UI; the marketing sells 'spam number rotation'. The Terms make the buyer warrant consent to record and to train on voice data, and disclaim regulatory fitness. The privacy policy is the legacy gig-worker notice with no DPDP notice for the people called. OpenAI and Plivo are US subprocessors despite the claim 'all data within India'. Claimed but unverified: a hard 9:30-20:30 window and 'configurable AI disclosure'.

Inference: SquadStack's headline numbers do not reconcile. Arth's '1 crore minutes in two months at 80% of traffic' implies about 2 lakh AI minutes a day (INR 15-37 Cr a year at INR 2-5, the same order as FY24 revenue of INR 26.5 Cr), so '50 lakh+ calls a day' is about 0.04 min per call, meaning dial attempts. Other contradictions: training data 600M vs 900M minutes vs 3B interactions; 20+ vs 1,000+ voices; a setup fee per use case vs '$0'; the 'Turing test' dated September, October or November 2025 and scored as 'picked at least one of two AI recordings as human'.

Proposed: against SquadStack, VP competes on five tasks we can run, not on logos or ASR: (1) minutes to first live call (SquadStack: weeks via sales); (2) a per-call technical failure reason visible beyond 10 days (SquadStack: outcome labels plus aggregate STT/LLM/TTS counts); (3) real-time voicemail/AMD (SquadStack: post-call transcript keywords); (4) compliance and honesty by construction: 1600/140 routing, consent capture and a fixed AI disclosure (SquadStack: number rotation, buyer-warranted consent, configurable disclosure); (5) published pricing with no setup fee. Head-on pre-sale BFSI, where SquadStack holds logos and outcome pricing, stays out of v1.
nodes.rationale: Observed SquadStack surface (claims SQS-11, SQS-18, SQS-34, SQS-37, SQS-47..SQS-50) and its BPO-shaped data model; buyer complaints elsewhere are ~70% support, billing and account-UI (l4a/r2).
nodes.reverse_if: The account phase or buyer interviews show any of: SquadStack/Osno self-serve sign-up to first PSTN call in under 30 min; per-call technical failure reasons shown to customers; real-time AMD; or 1600-series routing with fixed disclosure. Also reverse if the listener panel or a pilot shows that VP's fixed AI disclosure raises hang-ups by more than 5 points over undisclosed agents.

nodes.title: SquadStack teaches Indian enterprise buyers that winning means being mistaken for a human. Its naturalness KPI counts calls dropped after the caller realises it is an AI; it markets a 'Turing test' and 'configurable AI disclosure'. Buyers may score VP's never-deny, disclose-once rule as a naturalness loss in bake-offs.
nodes.mitigation: Measure the effect of one-time light disclosure on hang-ups within 10 s and on task success, in the listener panel and the first pilot. Sell the rule as regulatory and brand safety (DPDP, TRAI, RBI/IRDAI conduct). Never relax the rule; it is a standing owner rule.

nodes.title: REA on SquadStack: neither the HAR nor the CDP bundle path produced evidence.
nodes.tried: npx rea-agents@latest inspect on a Playwright 1.56 HAR (content embedded) of ai-platform.squadstack.ai; analyze-web-bundle over CDP (headless Chromium 141, port 9334) with --fetch-source-maps and 6 s of observation.
nodes.broke: inspect: 'Cannot open artifact: unsupported binary format' (target_unavailable). analyze-web-bundle: no stdout or stderr, killed by the 280 s timeout. rea doctor reports healthy:false (analysis engines missing). Fallback that worked: the Next.js _buildManifest route map plus direct download of the 98 public chunks, and HAR body extraction.

nodes.title: SquadStack account phase. Its Terms bar using the Platform 'for competitive purposes' and 'automated means', and require that users not misrepresent their affiliation. Is there a lawful route to the time-and-motion tasks? Is self-serve sign-up at ai-platform.squadstack.ai or app.osno.ai even open? Until resolved, Instinct must not create a SquadStack or Osno account for the teardown.
nodes.closes_when: SquadStack gives written consent for an evaluation account under VP's own identity (then run the 14 predictions in predictions.json), or 3 or more buyer interviews (e.g. IndiaMART, BankBazaar, Moneyview, Upstox, Shiprocket) supply onboarding time, failure-reason visibility, number series, calling-window control, AMD/transfer behaviour and a written price.

nodes.title: SquadStack v2 reference. Marketed: Persistent Memory (lead-level, masked fingerprint, up to 20 plain-language extraction points, Refresh or Rolling History, pass-through or AI-summarised briefing, stale facts flagged), Lift (one prompt edit at a time, human-reviewed, locked compliance/pricing/identity sections, rollout from a small slice to 1/4, 1/2 and all traffic) and Optimize (80/20 splits, significance flag). Observed in code: context summarisation (5-turn threshold, keeps 3), model hot-swap and fallback, agent evals, prompt-version history. No memory or Lift screen is in the public bundles.

SquadStack's public failure record is supply-side, not buyer-side. Capterra has 0 reviews; G2, Trustpilot and SourceForge are behind 403 (not bypassed). The partner app (com.squad.run; 15,007 ratings, 3.85 stars) shows payouts stuck for months, no work for 6 months after passing assessments, deactivations with money held, a stated hiring pause and templated replies (Jun-Jul 2026). Its managed 'human advisors' fallback sits on a shrinking gig pool (FY24 revenue halved).

events.details:
SquadStack lane finished the account-free phase: 69 graded claims (45 observed, 11 inferred, 12 vendor-claimed, 1 unknown) and 14 pre-registered predictions.
- Architecture (observed in its own public bundles and trust centre): a Pipecat cascade with Daily for web; TTS ElevenLabs (default, India residency) / Cartesia / Sarvam; STT sarvam / cartesia / squadstack_ws / arc_stt; Gemini 2.5 Flash via OpenRouter; Exotel, Ozonetel and Plivo telephony; AWS Mumbai; Django. Contradicts 'owned, not orchestrated'.
- Self-serve: the unlinked ai-platform.squadstack.ai, a probable Osno AI brand, platform PM roles and a Plug-N-Play SME wallet flow.
- API: lead ingestion and disposition webhooks only.
- Plumbing: DNC/DND and DLT fields present; no 140/1600; number rotation; consent warranted by the buyer; the privacy notice is not DPDP-shaped.
- Price: no public rate; INR 2-5 FAQ unchanged; 50% of the first month as setup fee in Plug-N-Play; COGS inference INR 1.1-3.6/min by TTS choice.
- Failures: the public record is supply-side (gig payouts, no work).
- Terms bar competitive and automated use, so no SquadStack/Osno account without written consent.
- REA: inspect rejected the HAR; analyze-web-bundle timed out. The harness refused report.md.
